profile.text: Higashi student Kirara, chose to leave home due to her Oripathy. After sending out an SOS message to her former classmates, she got a reply from Utage and sought treatment from Rhodes Island following instructions. Has a considerable understanding of electronic equipment. Presently providing assistance to Rhodes Island with broadcast communications and equipment maintenance.
